verdict.rationale: Document conversion fidelity is a fair question for a file-conversion service, but the evidence pack has no claim or test showing that layout, fonts, images, or tables are preserved. The only nearby item is the ability to pin a fixed LibreOffice version. That is a version-stability control, not evidence of fidelity, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, document conversion preserves layout, fonts, images, and tables rather than flattening them
